title: Fourteen calendar days to report a change of Manager of Record
subtopic: Reporting a change of Manager of Record
rule_summary: A pharmacy LOCATED IN MASSACHUSETTS shall notify the Board WITHIN 14 CALENDAR DAYS of the resignation, termination, or change of its Manager of Record, and an application for change of Manager of Record shall satisfy this requirement. A NON-RESIDENT pharmacy shall notify the Board within 14 calendar days of the resignation, termination, or change of its Massachusetts licensed designated pharmacist in charge, and an application for change of Massachusetts licensed designated pharmacist in charge shall satisfy this requirement. Separately, A MANAGER OF RECORD shall notify the Board of his or her resignation or termination as Manager of Record within 14 calendar days.
exam_relevance: Supplies the clock that 247 CMR 6.10 does not state: the change-of-Manager-of-Record application is also the 14-calendar-day report of an event that has already happened, and the departing Manager of Record owes a separate personal notice on the same period.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy reporting regulations

numeric_facts.fact: Pharmacy's deadline to notify the Board of a change of Manager of Record
numeric_facts.conditions: from the resignation, termination or change; an application for change of Manager of Record satisfies it

numeric_facts.fact: Departing Manager of Record's own deadline to notify the Board
numeric_facts.conditions: from his or her resignation or termination as Manager of Record

common_confusions: 247 CMR 6.10 states no day count of its own; the period comes from 247 CMR 20.05.
The pharmacy's duty and the departing Manager of Record's personal duty are separate, so the pharmacy's application does not discharge the individual's notice.
The period runs forward from the resignation, termination or change, so the change may already have taken effect when the application is filed.
verification_notes: Read in the current official text of 247 CMR 20.00: Reporting published at mass.gov on 2026-09-11. Added as a new rule so that no released adjudication is disturbed.
